description: Move a scheduled post (any network) to a new publish time, on every network target that is not yet published. Only posts with status scheduled can be moved: a paused post answers 409 POST_NOT_RESCHEDULABLE (use resume_post with scheduledAt instead), a draft or published one too. The time must respect the minimum lead (400 SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON). Approval is NOT changed or bypassed: an approved post stays approved, an unapproved one still needs a human. Requires scope POSTS_WRITE.

scheduledAt.description: New publish time, ISO 8601 WITH time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z or +02:00. Must be at least 10 minutes from now, otherwise SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON (not retryable; the error names the earliest allowed time).

name: reschedule_post
title: Reschedule post
